watch.summary: A streamer accidentally flies off a cliff into the woods during a driving race, somehow navigates through the trees to cross the finish line, but refuses to count it as a real victory.

beats.what: Streamer drives along a winding forest road in a rally game.
He loses control and flies off the cliff edge into the trees.
He drives through bushes and hits the finish line from an unintended path.
He realizes it was a messy fluke and refuses to count the win.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: That is not an actual win.
watch.why: The clip works on gameplay visual chaos as the streamer flies off-road and survives. His self-imposed standard of rejecting the win adds a funny finishing button to the clip.
